i18n.zh-Hans: 模块名称的规范。
i18n.en-US: The specification of module name.

availability_zone.description: The available zone to launch ecs instance and other resources.

i18n.zh-Hans: 可用区用于启动ECS实例和其他资源。
i18n.en-US: The available zone to launch ECS instance and other resources.

i18n.zh-Hans: 模块描述的规范。
i18n.en-US: The specification of module description.

image_id.description: The image id used to launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个ECS实例的镜像ID。
i18n.en-US: The image id used to launch one or more ECS instances.

image_name_regex.description: The regex string used to search image launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于搜索图像以启动一个或多个 ECS 实例的正则表达式字符串。
i18n.en-US: The regex string used to search for launching one or more ECS instances.

instance_type.description: The instance type used to launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个ECS实例的实例类型。
i18n.en-US: The instance type used to launch one or more ECS instances.

host_name.description: Host name used on all instances as prefix. Like if the value is TF-ECS-Host-Name and then the final host name would be TF-ECS-Host-Name001, TF-ECS-Host-Name002 and so on.

i18n.zh-Hans: 在所有实例中用作前缀的主机名。例如，如果值是TF-ECS-Host-Name，那么最终的主机名将是TF-ECS-Host-Name001、TF-ECS-Host-Name002，依此类推。
i18n.en-US: Host name used on all instances as prefix. Like if the value is TF-ECS-Host-Name and then the final host name would be TF-ECS-Host-Name001, TF-ECS-Host-Name002 and so on.

i18n.zh-Hans: 发动机的规格。
i18n.en-US: The specification of the engine.

engine_version.description: The specification of the engine version.

i18n.zh-Hans: 数据库引擎版本。
i18n.en-US: The specification of the engine version.

rds_instance_type.description: The specification of the rds instance type.

i18n.zh-Hans: RDS实例类型的规格。
i18n.en-US: The specification of the RDS instance type.

instance_storage.description: The specification of the instance storage.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例存储的规格。
i18n.en-US: The specification of the instance storage.

instance_charge_type.description: The specification of the instance charge type.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例收费类型的规格。
i18n.en-US: The specification of the instance charge type.

monitoring_period.description: The specification of the monitoring period.

i18n.zh-Hans: 监控周期的规格。
i18n.en-US: The specification of the monitoring period.

rds_disk_category.description: The specification of the database disk category.

i18n.zh-Hans: 数据库磁盘类别的规格。
i18n.en-US: The specification of the database disk category.

i18n.zh-Hans: 实例的密码。
i18n.en-US: The password of instance.

kms_encrypted_password.description: An KMS encrypts password used to an instance. It is conflicted with 'password'.

i18n.zh-Hans: An KMS加密了用于实例的密码。它与'password'冲突。
i18n.en-US: An KMS encrypts password used for an instance. It conflicts with 'password'.

kms_encryption_context.description: An KMS encryption context used to decrypt 'kms_encrypted_password' before creating or updating an instance with 'kms_encrypted_password'.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于在创建或更新实例之前解密'kms_encrypted_password'的KMS加密上下文。
i18n.en-US: An KMS encryption context used to decrypt 'kms_encrypted_password' before creating or updating an instance with 'kms_encrypted_password'.

system_disk_size.description: The system disk size used to launch one or more ecs instances.

i18n.zh-Hans: 用于启动一个或多个ECS实例的系统盘大小。
i18n.en-US: The system disk size used to launch one or more ECS instances.

user_data.description: User data to pass to instance on boot.

i18n.zh-Hans: 引导时传递给实例的用户数据。
i18n.en-US: User data to pass to instance on boot.

key_name.description: The name of SSH key pair that can login ECS instance successfully without password. If it is specified, the password would be invalid.

i18n.zh-Hans: 可以成功免密登录ECS实例的SSH密钥对名称。如果指定了此参数，则密码将无效。
i18n.en-US: The name of the SSH key pair that can log into the ECS instance successfully without a password. If it is specified, the password will be invalid.

i18n.zh-Hans: 安全增强策略。
i18n.en-US: The security enhancement strategy.

disk_category.description: The specification of the disk category.

i18n.zh-Hans: 磁盘类别的规格。
i18n.en-US: The specification of the disk category.
